keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «여러 중국 통치자들이 약 2,000년 동안 북쪽의 공격에서 땅을 지키려고 성벽을 쌓고 또 쌓았다(주제)» 와 «만리장성은 사람들이 여러 세기 동안 힘을 모아 나라를 지켰음을 보여 준다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (Chinese rulers built and rebuilt the wall over about 2,000 years to protect their land) and the conclusion (it shows how people worked together for centuries to protect their country). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: A long series of walls, towers, and forts built over 2,000 years

boxes.qen: What is the myth about the wall?
boxes.a: That it can be seen from space

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

a sign that tells people about danger

qs.q: Why did China’s first astronaut say he could not see the wall from space?
qs.qko: 중국 최초의 우주 비행사가 우주에서 성벽을 볼 수 없었다고 한 이유는 무엇인가요?
opts: Because the wall is narrow and its color is like the land around it
Because the wall is hidden under the sea
Because the wall is too short to see
evs: The wall is narrow, and its color is similar to the land around it, so China's first astronaut said he could not see it.
If you add up all its sections, it is more than 20,000 kilometers long.
Most of the wall visitors see today was built about 500 years ago, during the Ming Dynasty.
Suddenly, you see a column of smoke rising from the next tower.
why: 성벽은 폭이 좁고 색깔이 주변 땅과 비슷해서, 중국 최초의 우주 비행사도 볼 수 없었다고 했어요.
The wall is narrow, and its color is similar to the land around it, so the astronaut could not see it.

qs.q: In "a column of smoke rising from the next tower," what does "column" mean?
qs.qko: «a column of smoke rising from the next tower» 에서 «column» 은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: a tall, thin shape going straight up
evs: Suddenly, you see a column of smoke rising from the next tower.
It is not one single wall but a long series of walls, towers, and forts.
Because it is so long, many people believe it can be seen from space.
Today, millions of people visit this UNESCO World Heritage Site every year.
why: 연기가 옆 망루에서 «솟아오르고(rising)» 있다고 했으니, «column» 은 위로 길게 뻗은 기둥 모양을 뜻해요.
The smoke is «rising» from the tower, so a «column» of smoke is a tall, thin shape going straight up.

qs.q: How did soldiers send a warning along the wall?
qs.qko: 병사들은 성벽을 따라 어떻게 경고를 전했나요?
opts: They saw smoke from the next tower and lit a fire to pass the warning on
They rode fast horses to the capital city
They wrote letters and sent them by boat
evs: Suddenly, you see a column of smoke rising from the next tower.
Different Chinese rulers built and rebuilt it over about 2,000 years to protect their land from attacks from the north.
You quickly light a fire to pass the warning on.
why: 옆 망루에서 연기가 솟는 것을 보면, 병사는 재빨리 불을 피워 경고를 다음 망루로 전했어요. 두 문장을 이어야 해요.
When a soldier saw smoke rising from the next tower, he quickly lit a fire to pass the warning on. You need both sentences.

ends: How did people build such a long wall without modern machines?
현대식 기계 없이 사람들은 어떻게 그렇게 긴 성벽을 쌓았을까요?
What other amazing places are on the UNESCO World Heritage list?
유네스코 세계 유산에는 또 어떤 놀라운 곳들이 있을까요?

write.src: “I think <u>the Great Wall is amazing</u> because <u>people worked on it for many centuries</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 글에서 찾은 사실을 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because it is over 20,000 kilometers long)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», use a fact from the text to make your reason clear. (e.g. because it is over 20,000 kilometers long)
